pairs.recommendation: Learner-approved primary real-world benchmark candidate; model, architecture, and expected scoring answers remain unapproved.
proposedChecks: English proficiency can be evidenced through different routes; an IELTS listing is not an IELTS-only rule.
Preserve the policy-specific grade/level and timing conditions; a brochure summary does not promise unconditional postgraduate eligibility.

The sources use differing certificate names; do not silently establish exact qualification equivalence when the supplied text does not establish it. Unresolved identity/applicability is Insufficient Evidence, not a fabricated contradiction.
College English-course entry evidence differs from postgraduate degree-entry requirements; never infer that the applicant has completed a pathway or earned a required grade.
pairs.limits: No genuine contradiction established. Comparison taxonomy and expected topic-level gold answers need learner review. Provider token/latency budgets still untested.
learnerRequirements: Distinguish standard English requirements from conditional Academic English pathways.
Do not infer certificate equivalence from similar names.
Completing any English course does not guarantee exemption.
Retain synthetic documents for contradictions, missing evidence, and applicant-specific exceptions.
